name: tpl-precedence-4-goal
task: Reach the exit, but you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) hard is the reach-the-exit goal, and Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) hard puts the switch toggle before the exit. Together with the hard goal, the chain forces the toggle, so no separate Existence(switch_toggled) is needed.

texts: Reach the exit: the agent must stand on the exit cell at some point in the episode.
The agent must have flipped (toggled) the switch before reaching the exit: the exit is not reached before the switch has been toggled.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u3
(u1, at_exit) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled, u1) -> 1
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled, u2) -> -10
(u0, at_exit&switch_toggled, u3) -> 12
(u1, at_exit, u3) -> 11
